risks.title: Perte du droit exclusif de cotation et de négociation d’options d’indice
risks.score_rationale: Listed first in risk summary with strong language ('material adverse effect'). Loss of exclusive rights to products like S&P 500 index options would directly impact majority of Options segment revenue and overall profitability. Citation: "See Management s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,' Note 4". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: The Company could lose exclusive rights to list and trade certain index options and futures products, particularly index options, significantly reducing market share and rentability.
risks.title_en: Loss of exclusive index options listing and trading rights

risks.title: Concurrence tarifaire intense et commoditisation des produits
risks.score_rationale: Described with strong language ('intense price competition', 'intensify'). Directly impacts transactional revenue across all segments, with derivatives products increasingly commoditized. Citation: "Competitive Strengths Cboe is a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products across cash". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Increasing price competition from competitors and industry consolidation pressures CBOE to lower transaction fees and market data pricing, reducing margins and revenues.
risks.title_en: Intense price competition and product commoditization

risks.title: Conditions de marché économiques, politiques et géopolitiques
risks.score_rationale: Listed in risk summary with multiple cited factors. Directly impacts trading volumes and market data revenues which are sensitive to market activity and volatility levels. Citation: "We provide data services to market participants globally through a number of distribution channels including". Position: bas Item 1A.
risks.summary: Adverse global economic, political, and geopolitical conditions can reduce demand for CBOE's products and services, resulting in lower trading and clearing volumes.
risks.title_en: Economic, political, and geopolitical market conditions

risks.title: Vulnérabilités cybersécurité et pannes de systèmes
risks.score_rationale: Highlighted in risk summary with references to 'security vulnerabilities and breaches' and ability to 'accommodate trading and clearing volume without failure'. System failures are operationally critical for an exchange. Citation: "As of January 1, 2025, the Futures segment prospectively includes all Digital operating activity, which". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Security vulnerabilities or breaches in CBOE's trading and clearing systems could cause service disruptions, operational failures, or data compromises, damaging reputation and customer relationships.

risks.title: Regulatory and legislative changes
risks.score_rationale: Listed in risk summary ('legal and regulatory obligations', 'legislative or regulatory changes'). Broad impact on operations including market structure rules, tax regimes, and compliance costs. Citation: "This includes associated transaction and clearing fees, the portion of market data fees relating to". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: Changes in regulations, market structure rules, or tax regimes could increase compliance costs and affect CBOE's revenue models and competitive positioning.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party service providers
risks.score_rationale: Listed in risk summary ('dependence on and exposure to risk from third parties'). Introduces operational and business continuity risks given CBOE's reliance on external vendors. Citation: "As of January 1, 2025, the Futures segment prospectively includes all Digital operating activity, which". Position: milieu Item 1A.
risks.summary: CBOE's dependence on third-party providers for critical services introduces operational risks and potential business continuity threats if vendors fail or underperform.

risks.title: Perte de clients clés et baisse du volume de transactions
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in risk summary ('loss of key customers or significant reduction in trading or clearing volumes'). Direct impact on transaction-based revenues which comprise majority of operating income. Citation: "See Management s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,' Note 4". Position: milieu Item 1A.

company_description: Cboe Global Markets, Inc., through its subsidiaries, operates as a derivatives and securities exchange network that delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing, and investment solutions in the United States and internationally. It operates through five segments: Options, North American Equities, Europe and Asia Pacific, Futures, and Global FX. The Options segment includes options on market indices, as well as on the stocks of individual corporations and on trading solutions and products in multiple asset classes, including equities, derivatives, and FX, across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific (ETPs), such as exchange-traded funds (ETFs) and exchange-traded notes (ETNs); and trading in listed options through a single system. The North American Equities segment comprising U.S. equities and ETP transaction services. This segment also includes listing services on Cboe Canada, ETP listings on BZX, the Cboe Global Markets, Inc. common stock listing, and applicable market data. risks_rationale_fr.0: Cité en tête du résumé des risques (langage fort "material adverse effect"). Perte des droits exclusifs (options S&P 500) impacterait directement la majorité des revenus Options.

risks.title: Loss of exclusive index options listing and trading rights
risks.description: Listed first in risk summary with strong language ('material adverse effect'). Loss of exclusive rights to products like S&P 500 index options would directly impact majority of Options segment revenue and overall profitability.
risks.summary: The Company could lose exclusive rights to list and trade certain index options and futures products, particularly index options, significantly reducing market share and rentability.
risks.score_rationale: Citation: "The key products traded on our derivatives markets are proprietary products, including our flagship products". Position: milieu Item 1A.

risks.title: Intense price competition and product commoditization
risks.description: Described with strong language ('intense price competition', 'intensify'). Directly impacts transactional revenue across all segments, with derivatives products increasingly commoditized.
risks.summary: Increasing price competition from competitors and industry consolidation pressures CBOE to lower transaction fees and market data pricing, reducing margins and revenues.
risks.score_rationale: Citation: "In particular, you should consider the risks and uncertainties described under 'Risk Factors' in this". Position: haut Item 1A.

risks.title: Economic, political, and geopolitical market conditions
risks.description: Listed in risk summary with multiple cited factors. Directly impacts trading volumes and market data revenues which are sensitive to market activity and volatility levels.
risks.summary: Adverse global economic, political, and geopolitical conditions can reduce demand for CBOE's products and services, resulting in lower trading and clearing volumes.
risks.score_rationale: Citation: "The segment also includes transaction services for U.S. government securities executed on the Cboe Fixed". Position: milieu Item 1A.

risks.title: Cybersecurity vulnerabilities and system failures
risks.description: Highlighted in risk summary with references to 'security vulnerabilities and breaches' and ability to 'accommodate trading and clearing volume without failure'. System failures are operationally critical for an exchange.
risks.summary: Security vulnerabilities or breaches in CBOE's trading and clearing systems could cause service disruptions, operational failures, or data compromises, damaging reputation and customer relationships.
risks.score_rationale: Citation: "As of January 1, 2025, the Futures segment prospectively includes all Digital operating activity, which". Position: milieu Item 1A.

risks.title: Regulatory and legislative changes
risks.description: Listed in risk summary ('legal and regulatory obligations', 'legislative or regulatory changes'). Broad impact on operations including market structure rules, tax regimes, and compliance costs.
risks.summary: Changes in regulations, market structure rules, or tax regimes could increase compliance costs and affect CBOE's revenue models and competitive positioning.
risks.score_rationale: Citation: "See Management s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations,' Note 4". Position: milieu Item 1A.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party service providers
risks.description: Listed in risk summary ('dependence on and exposure to risk from third parties'). Introduces operational and business continuity risks given CBOE's reliance on external vendors.
risks.summary: CBOE's dependence on third-party providers for critical services introduces operational risks and potential business continuity threats if vendors fail or underperform.
risks.score_rationale: Citation: "As of January 1, 2025, the Futures segment prospectively includes all Digital operating activity, which". Position: milieu Item 1A.

risks.title: Loss of key customers and trading volume declines
risks.description: Mentioned in risk summary ('loss of key customers or significant reduction in trading or clearing volumes'). Direct impact on transaction-based revenues which comprise majority of operating income.
risks.summary: Loss of major customers or significant declines in their trading volumes would directly reduce CBOE's transaction revenues and operating profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Citation: "We provide data services to market participants globally through a number of distribution channels including". Position: bas Item 1A.
